svg.title: Draw it: the year in one page, with its numbers
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw four boxes for the four terms with the one piece of arithmetic each term turned on written inside it, draw the ladder of seven gates with an honest tick or cross beside each rung, and draw the one thing they would now do differently with an arrow to the week they would move it to.
svg.text: Draw it: the year in one page, with its numbers
1. four boxes, one per term, each holding the ONE sum that term turned on
2. the ladder of seven Level 4 gates, with an honest tick or cross on every rung
3. the one thing you would now do differently, with an arrow to the week for it
